item.title: Jabberwocky Babel
item.description:
Useful Gibberish

Writing in the era of AI is difficult; it requires knowing and bowing to your own inadequacy in the face of the machine.

Take, for example: I built a simple scoring mechanic to improve my writing. I could have done this with regard to any aspect of my life. The idea: you make a draft. You score it. You pass the criticisms back to the AI. The AI improves it. You score it again. And so on.
